description: Implementation of the Moondream vision service, integrating with a vision-language model for image analysis and description generation within the Pipecat project. Defines the MoondreamService class, device detection, and image processing methods.

classes.name: MoondreamService
classes.description: A vision-language model service that analyzes images and generates descriptions using the Moondream model, supporting hardware acceleration options.

methods.name: detect_device()
methods.description: Detects the available hardware (XPU, CUDA, MPS, or CPU) and returns the appropriate device and data type for model inference.

methods.name: __init__( self, *, model="vikhyatk/moondream2", revision="2025-01-09", use_cpu=False, **kwargs )
methods.description: Initializes the MoondreamService with model parameters and loads the model on the appropriate device.

methods.name: AsyncGenerator[Frame,None] run_vision(self, frame: UserImageRawFrame)
methods.description: Processes an image frame asynchronously, generates a description using the model, and yields different stages of response frames.

ctags.name: get_image_description
ctags.pattern: /^        def get_image_description(image_bytes: bytes, text: Optional[str]) -> str:$/

ctags.name: run_vision
ctags.pattern: /^    async def run_vision(self, frame: UserImageRawFrame) -> AsyncGenerator[Frame, None]:$/
